🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 5, 2026

Moon, in Leo, holds a square to Venus, in detriment in Scorpio. Two different appetites, forced into one conversation: what you own is being counted by somebody else’s arithmetic.

Easier — Saying no to a thing you can afford and do not want.
Harder — Treating a passing squeeze as a permanent condition.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon in Leo flows toward you — nothing resists, which is the risk. Fire that starts things, started cheaply. Mars has not been in Cancer for four weeks.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Moon squares you from Leo, and the cost objects. Earth holds on, and the holding is billed. Venus left Libra four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon in Leo makes room for you, and then waits. Air that changes shape, and the shape fits. Since Mercury crossed out of Virgo, the question has changed.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, untitled in Leo. Venus trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Cardinal water opens the account without argument. The hold Mercury had a week ago is not there any more.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, falls in Libra. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Fire holds until owning and being coincide. Four weeks of Virgo ended, and nothing carried over.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, where nothing is owed to it. From Scorpio, Venus makes something possible and nothing certain. Mutable earth: two answers, neither expensive. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. From Leo, Moon offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Air begins, and beginning asks little today. The conjunction of three weeks ago is off it now.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you from Leo on plain terms, without privilege. Moon squares you from Leo: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Fixed water pays to hold on. The square to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. From Leo, Moon concedes the point early. Fire bends, and bending costs nothing here. Two weeks ago Jupiter was still held by Mercury; that is finished.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Venus in Scorpio opens a gap you have to step into. Cardinal earth: the opening move is the cheap one. What pressed two weeks ago has cleared.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. From Scorpio, Venus cuts across the appetite. Air keeps its grip past the point it is worth. This is days old, not weeks, and behaves like it.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Venus in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Water adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. Seven days ago none of this was in place.
